card.name: The word injection in dosing text
card.fires_on: The word "injection" (or its start, "inject") in dosage and administration text, especially after route words like subcutaneous or intravenous, or after "an" or "of".

modes.label: Injection after a route or article
modes.description: "injection" follows a route word or article in a sentence about how a drug is given.
